name: CAPACITY_CONSTRAINED_THREE_PHASE_EXISTENCE_TEST
scope: Full frozen measured E/H identity union, original task-quality admission and Module14F memory unchanged; first reproducible witness only.
background_rule: Independently required VQA request every5s; all three admitted G paths compete, no Specialist VQA exists. Background unchanged at every stage.
primary_objective: minimum measured safe residency over full model pool and all available measured counts
secondary_objective: among ALL equal minimum-safe-memory states, unchanged frozen J-router; no preceding replica-count objective and no artificial G/S forcing
baseline: Original V3 full-pool J-first discrete solver, same rates/budget/empirical catalog; CPU comparison only
candidate_requirements: 0<CG<CS, real G task and background measurements, real S task measurement, G1+S1 measured memory fits unchanged budget

point_checks.LOW: full-pool optimum has exactly candidate G1 and no target S
point_checks.MID: same G1 present, exactly candidate S1, target S fraction>=.8
point_checks.HIGH: same G1/S1 are optimum, both routes strictly positive, target rate>CS, max predicted rho<=.78 (selection margin only; operational gate remains .8)

acceptance: All three globally minimum-memory full-pool states with accepted unmodified J-routing; same G, S, budget, background; rejects any point where competitors replace G or choose other measured count/family. Missing replica counts not treated as impossible.
witness_choice: First complete candidate under declared order; first acceptable fraction for each stage; no GPU results consulted.

GPU_protocol.stability: unchanged stability_v2 DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS; all9 must be steady and memory-budget-valid; HIGH all3 must contain actual G and S target completions
GPU_protocol.E2E_latency: report target/background/system mean and P95, no undefined SLO claims
